environment.description: Same Quarkus 3.2 application deployed on AWS Lambda via quarkus-amazon-lambda-http extension behind API Gateway. Split.io SDK initialized with workspace 'prod-secure' using server-side key 'prod-xyz789'. The targeting rules for split 'direct_transfer_csrf_bypass' were updated on 2024-01-15 to return 'off' as the default treatment with no percentage-based allocation and no individual targeting rules active. The kill switch for this split is NOT engaged (split is active, not killed). The default treatment in the split definition YAML is set to 'off'. Note: the application property app.csrf.legacy-mode remains 'true' in the deployment manifest but this property is only consulted when the SDK returns 'control' (SDK initialization failure). The Split SDK is configured with connectionTimeout=15000ms and readyTimeout=30000ms with impressionsMode=OPTIMIZED. SDK health endpoint at /admin/split-health returns 200. The environment also has a custom Quarkus CDI interceptor registered at priority 100 that logs all treatment evaluations to CloudWatch but does not modify them.

config.split_flag_state: direct_transfer_csrf_bypass: default_treatment='off', no targeting rules, kill_switch=inactive
config.monitoring: CDI interceptor logs treatments to CloudWatch, priority=100
